verdict.rationale: Vanta's own pages say its in-product AI reviews evidence, flags gaps, and suggests fixes. They also describe a Vanta AI Agent that flags issues and supports agentic search and questions across policies, controls, frameworks, tests and documents. That covers in-product AI insights and suggestions drawn from the user's compliance data; MCP-based assistant access was not counted because it runs outside the product. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on how the insights and suggestions are generated and shown, and independent or hands-on corroboration beyond marketing pages.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Vanta AI reviews evidence, flags gaps, and suggests fixes so you're ready faster with less manual work.
working tirelessly across the Vanta platform to draft policies, complete questionnaires, and flag issues before they escalate.
Vanta AI Agent, including agentic search and asking questions (across policies, controls, frameworks, tests, documents)
